headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would temporarily lead the Office of Management and Budget if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order sets up a line of succession at the Office of Management and Budget (OMB), the White House office that helps prepare the federal budget and oversees how agencies are run. It names which officials would step in to act as Director if the Director and other top leaders are absent, unable to serve, or the job is vacant. No summary was provided, so the specific officials and conditions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Office of Management and Budget
who_it_affects.how: They are placed in a set order for who would temporarily perform the Director's duties when needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the material provided; the order was signed January 13, 2005.
